hub-ensemble.methods: Equal-weight linear pool of all submitted sample trajectories; 100 trajectories resampled from the pooled set.

mockA-renewal.methods: Renewal equation with time-varying Rt and province-specific reporting delays.
mockA-renewal.data_inputs: Hub target data and auxiliary reporting delays (synthetic demo).

mockB-growth.methods: Negative-binomial log-linear growth model fitted to the last six weeks.
mockB-growth.data_inputs: Hub target data and auxiliary reporting delays (synthetic demo).

mockC-spatial.methods: Gravity-model metapopulation with importation hazard to unaffected provinces.
mockC-spatial.data_inputs: Hub target data and auxiliary reporting delays (synthetic demo).
